text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ch3 class=\"post-title entry-title\"\u003EA 31 year old male with chief complaints of vomiting\u003C\/h3\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E6th dec 2023\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"post-body entry-content float-container\" id=\"post-body-5870972019952767976\"\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;This is an an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;I have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient\/ attender was informed the purpose of the information being acquired. An informed consent was taken from patient\/ attender and there is omission of information that was requested to be omitted.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ECONSENT WAS GIVEN BY BOTH PATIENT AND ATTENDERS\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS\u003C\/b\u003E:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EVomitings 7-8 episodes\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPain epigastrium\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS\u003C\/b\u003E:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 day back and then he developed vomiting of 7-8 episodes after consumption of alcohol which was non bilious, non projectile, not tinged with blood,food particles as content.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPain aching type of pain in epigastrium sudden in onset non radiating relived on taking medications\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O hallucinations since 3 yrs auditory and visual hallucinations no suicidal tendency some times he behaves aggressively\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O fever with chills, cold , cough,headache\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O jaundice, pruritis, diarrhoea, constipation\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O burning micturition, hematuria , oliguria\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O breathing difficulty, chest pain\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPAST HISTORY\u003C\/b\u003E:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo similar complaints in the past\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot a known case DM, HTN, Bronchial asthma, epilepsy, CVA, CAD\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMLC CASE\u0026nbsp; history of fall under the influence of alcohol 5days back\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPeriorbital swelling on the right eye with multiple abrasions on the skin on right side with sub conjunctival haemorrhage on the right side\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u003C\/b\u003E:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMarried\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMixed diet , Appetite normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENormal bowel and bladder movements\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is alcoholic consumes\u0026nbsp; (since 2016)12-13 quarters daily according to CAGE score he has dependency to alcohol , Allergic to egg , chicken\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EDAILY ROUTINE\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient wakes up at 6' O clock , then he goes to gym for 1 hour morning he will be having tea and breakfast\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E10 to 1pm goes to work ( auto driver)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThen takes rest from 1 to 4 pm\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAgain 4 to 8 drives auto and after 8 pm he\u0026nbsp; eats dinner , scrolls phone for about 1 hour and then goes to sleep\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPsychiatric problem\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was receiving treatment for 3 years for auditory and visual hallucinations no suicidal tendency some times he behaves aggressively\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EFAMILY HISTORY\u003C\/b\u003E:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENot significant\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPt is c\/c\/c\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo pallor,icterus,cyanosis, lymphadenopathy,clubbing,edema of feet\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centred online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Ci\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cbr class=\"Apple-interchange-newline\"\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDOA - 27\/11\/2023\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003ECHIEF COMPLAINTS\u003C\/u\u003E:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFever since 1 week\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpitations since 1 week\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGeneralised weakness since 4 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBlood in stools since 3 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EChest pain and tightness since 4 days\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENTING ILLNESS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThe patient was apparently asymptomatic 1 week ago and then she developed fever which is sudden in onset, high grade, associated with chills and rigors, relieved temporarily on medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPalpitations are present since 1 week which are regular and associated with chest discomfort\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is h\/o shortness of breath on exertion which is progressive (grade 2 to grade 3). No orthopnea, or PND.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is associated generalised weakness since 4 days and blood in stools since 3 days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is no h\/o vomitings, loose stools, pain abdomen, giddiness.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPAST HISTORY\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EN\/k\/c\/o DM, HTN, Asthma, TB, Epilepsy, CAD, CVA\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThere is h\/o tubectomy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep adequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel movement- Constipation present,
